confidence_notes: Local restaurant, beer, and cappuccino estimates use current Wollongong cost-of-living and menu-price references. Cocktail is a bounded estimate informed by local bar price ranges; wine by the glass is estimated relative to local draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without live lodging-price research and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wollongong is a mid-sized New South Wales coastal city with university and beach tourism demand. Food prices are benchmarked locally; lodging is modeled on regional Australian coastal-city levels below larger Sydney-market pricing.
